limitations: Coverage is conditional on the reviewed input pool, taxonomy and provenance groups, not a claim about all nonsymmetric PDE systems.
Unknown spatial methods never establish coverage of a known method.
Weak row dominance is a floating-point diagnostic, not a certificate.
Marginal regime coverage and distribution balance do not guarantee matching every joint regime or equal solver difficulty.
The development budget and equal objective weights are explicit benchmark design choices, not statistically estimated optimal values.

All input operators are retained. Numerical qualification uses fixed fresh targets after selection; failed qualification is reported and requires a versioned inventory revision, never a replacement draw chosen to pass.
